extractions.tool: convert.py: assets/js/scores.js applied to leaderboard.json (README, 'Each model entry holds only measured facts'; the site computes everything derivable in the browser): per model the knowledge subscore 0.7 freeform% + 0.3 multiple-choice%, the coding subscore (per difficulty 0.4 unit tests + 0.25 fully solved + 0.15 partially solved + 0.1 code quality + 0.1 valid syntax, blended 0.2 easy + 0.35 medium + 0.45 hard), composite = 0.5 knowledge + 0.5 coding; suite cost = sum over the five splits of (input tokens x input price + output tokens x output price) / 1e6 (null for electricity-priced models); token sums. Four decimals.
